goal: Deprecate the encryptwallet RPC ahead of removal to guide users toward creating encrypted wallets upfront
Avoid fund loss risks from invalidated backups, residual plaintext keys, and altered descriptor conditions
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Support because creating a new encrypted wallet and sending funds to it is cleaner (pablomartin4btc)
Concept support with request to keep test coverage for reload persistence (Eunovo)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because encrypting an existing wallet risks fund loss if pre-encryption backups are restored
Plaintext key remnants persist on storage media and imported descriptor spending conditions can change
